test_title: PYST 47: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the given letter series.

N _ B A N A _ A _ A N A N A B _ N A N A B A _ A N A
solution:
Given series: N _ B A N A _ A _ A N A N A B _ N A N A B A _ A N A

Option 1) ANANB→ N __A__ B A N A __N__ A __A__ A N A N A B __N__ N A N A B A __B__ A N A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) NANAB → N __N__ B A N A __A__ A __N__ A N A N A B __A__ N A N A B A __B__ A N A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) ANABN → N __A__ B A N A __N__ A __A__ A N A N A B __B__ N A N A B A __N__ A N A → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) ANBAN → N __**A**__ B A N A __**N**__ A __**B**__ A N A N A B __**A**__ N A N A B A __**N**__ A N A →** (It follows the pattern of: NA - BANANA - BANANA - BANANA - BANANA)**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
